disclaimer: Nutritional values are estimates based on Indian Food Composition Tables (IFCT 2017, ICMR-NIN) and documented composite recipe references. Street food recipes, portion sizes, deep-frying oil uptake, and butter/ghee additions vary significantly across vendors and regions.

Vada Pav.name: Vada Pav
Vada Pav.serving_description: 1 spiced potato batata vada in a pav bread bun with garlic-chili dry chutney and green chutney
Vada Pav.source_reference: NIN IFCT 2017 Code: C001 (Potato), B001 (Wheat Flour Bread); Composite snack estimation
Vada Pav.notes_uncertainty: Deep frying oil absorption in the chickpea flour batter (besan coating) varies between 8% to 15% by total weight depending on oil frying temperature.

Pav Bhaji.name: Pav Bhaji
Pav Bhaji.serving_description: Spiced mashed vegetable curry (potato, tomato, peas, capsicum) served with toasted buttered pav
Pav Bhaji.source_reference: Composite formulation: Potatoes (C001), Tomatoes (D067), Green Peas (A015), Butter (H001)
Pav Bhaji.notes_uncertainty: Street vendor variations frequently add between 15g to 40g of additional table butter per plate during griddle finishing.

Misal Pav.name: Misal Pav
Misal Pav.serving_description: Sprouted moth beans curry topped with spicy gravy (kat/tarri), farsan, onions, coriander, served with pav
Misal Pav.source_reference: Sprouted Moth Bean (Phaseolus aconitifolius, B014), Farsan/Sev composite
Misal Pav.notes_uncertainty: The lipid concentration is predominantly governed by the floating oil layer (tarri) and fried farsan topping.

Pani Puri.name: Pani Puri
Pani Puri.serving_description: Hollow crisp puris filled with spiced potato/chickpea mixture and flavored mint-tamarind water (6 pcs regular)
Pani Puri.source_reference: Semolina/Wheat puri (B001), Mint/Coriander herbs, Tamarind pulp (F026)
Pani Puri.notes_uncertainty: Puri thickness and sweetness ratio of meetha pani (tamarind jaggery water vs teekha pani) alters simple carbohydrate content.

Bhel Puri.name: Bhel Puri
Bhel Puri.serving_description: Puffed rice, diced vegetables, papdi, roasted peanuts, sev, tossed in tangy tamarind and mint chutneys
Bhel Puri.notes_uncertainty: Proportion of fried sev/papdi versus puffed rice and sweet jaggery chutney dictates fat and sugar levels.

Sev Puri.name: Sev Puri
Sev Puri.serving_description: Crisp flat papdis layered with diced potato, onions, three chutneys, and a heavy cover of gram flour sev (6 pcs regular)
Sev Puri.source_reference: Gram flour fried sev, refined wheat papdi, potato, chutneys
Sev Puri.notes_uncertainty: High variation based on quantity of fried sev garnished on top.

Dabeli.name: Dabeli
Dabeli.serving_description: Sweet and spicy potato mash with roasted masala peanuts, pomegranate pearls, sev in a toasted pav bun
Dabeli.source_reference: Pav bread, potato, roasted peanuts (D002), sweet chutney, sev
Dabeli.notes_uncertainty: Butter toasted on tawa adds roughly 5-10g fat per dabeli bun.

Samosa.name: Samosa
Samosa.serving_description: Crispy deep-fried triangular pastry stuffed with spiced potatoes, green peas, and whole spices (1 piece regular)
Samosa.source_reference: IFCT Cooked Snacks - Refined flour (Maida B002), Potato (C001), Oil absorption ~14%
Samosa.notes_uncertainty: Oil retention depends on dough ghee/shortening (moyen) and frying temperature.

Kachori.name: Kachori
Kachori.serving_description: Flaky deep-fried round pastry stuffed with spiced yellow moong dal or urad dal mixture
Kachori.source_reference: Moong Dal (B011), Refined Wheat Flour (B002), Vegetable Oil (E001)
Kachori.notes_uncertainty: Higher protein than potato-filled snacks due to split pulse stuffing, but significant deep-fry lipid content.

Dosa.name: Dosa
Dosa.serving_description: Crisp fermented rice and black gram crepe, served with sambar and coconut chutney
Dosa.source_reference: Rice (A001), Black gram dal (B009), Sesame/Vegetable oil
Dosa.notes_uncertainty: Ghee roast or butter roast preparation can raise total calories by 120-200 kcal over plain oil griddling.

Idli.name: Idli
Idli.serving_description: Steamed savory cakes made from fermented batter of de-husked black lentils and rice (2 pcs regular)
Idli.source_reference: NIN IFCT 2017 Standard Cooked Foods: Idli fermented steamed composite
Idli.notes_uncertainty: Pure steamed food with minimal inherent fat. Nutritional impact often depends on accompanying coconut chutney or ghee.

Medu Vada.name: Medu Vada
Medu Vada.serving_description: Crisp doughnut-shaped fritters made from spiced black gram (urad dal) batter (2 pcs regular)
Medu Vada.source_reference: Urad Dal (B009), Onion, Peppercorn, Deep frying oil absorption
Medu Vada.notes_uncertainty: Lentil batter naturally provides substantial protein, but porous structure absorbs frying oil if oil temperature drops below 175°C.

Poha.name: Poha
Poha.serving_description: Flattened rice tempered with mustard seeds, turmeric, green chilies, onions, roasted peanuts, and lemon
Poha.source_reference: Rice flakes/Flatted Rice (A006), Peanut (D002), Mustard, Turmeric
Poha.notes_uncertainty: Peanut quantity and tempering oil volume cause most variance in total calories and monounsaturated fatty acids.

Upma.name: Upma
Upma.serving_description: Thick roasted semolina porridge seasoned with mustard seeds, ginger, curry leaves, and vegetables
Upma.notes_uncertainty: Roasting medium (ghee vs refined oil) significantly affects saturated fat proportion.

Chole Bhature.name: Chole Bhature
Chole Bhature.serving_description: Spicy tangy chickpea curry served with 2 deep-fried puffed sourdough breads (bhature), pickles, and onions
Chole Bhature.source_reference: Chickpea/Kabuli Chana (B006), Refined Wheat Flour (B002), Deep-frying oil
Chole Bhature.notes_uncertainty: Bhature diameter, oil drainage, and ghee tadka in chole create substantial caloric variation (+/- 25%).

Aloo Tikki.name: Aloo Tikki
Aloo Tikki.serving_description: Crisp shallow-fried potato croquettes topped with curd (dahi), sweet tamarind chutney, and green chutney (2 pcs regular)
Aloo Tikki.notes_uncertainty: Shallow frying vs deep frying and sweetened curd toppings alter both fat and sugar contents.

Frankie.name: Frankie
Frankie.serving_description: Spiced vegetable/paneer filling rolled inside a thin roti wrapped with onion vinegar relish and chaat masala
Frankie.data_source: IFCT 2017 & Indian Street Food Rolls Analysis
Frankie.notes_uncertainty: Filling variation (potato cutlet base vs paneer or cheese additions) causes 100-150 kcal variance.

Sandwich.name: Bombay Veg Sandwich
Sandwich.serving_description: White bread layered with mint chutney, sliced beetroot, potato, cucumber, tomato, onion, and sandwich masala (toasted with butter)
Sandwich.source_reference: White bread (B001), Butter (H001), Fresh salad vegetables (Beetroot D008, Cucumber D023, Tomato D067)
Sandwich.notes_uncertainty: Toasted vs cold sandwich; addition of processed cheddar/amul cheese adds approx 90 kcal and 7g fat.

Jalebi.name: Jalebi
Jalebi.serving_description: Spiral-shaped fermented flour batter deep-fried in oil/ghee and soaked in saffron cardamom sugar syrup (3-4 pcs regular)
Jalebi.source_reference: NIN IFCT 2017 Cooked Sweets: Jalebi (Maida, Sugar cane sucrose F001, Ghee/Oil)
Jalebi.notes_uncertainty: Sugar syrup soaking duration and whether fried in desi ghee vs hydrogenated vegetable oil heavily affects fat and caloric density.

Other / Unknown Food.name: Other / Unknown Food
Other / Unknown Food.serving_description: Food item not recognized with sufficient statistical confidence or outside the current 19 street food classes
Other / Unknown Food.notes_uncertainty: Nutritional estimation is withheld to prevent incorrect dietary tracking for unverified or unknown items.
